description: OpenStreetMap node/7695403585. At the Donuzlav naval air station in annexed Crimea; the inscription marks the centenary of the 318th Independent Anti-Submarine Air Regiment on 27 April 2018 and was therefore erected UNDER RUSSIAN OCCUPATION; the airframe's own service history before 2014 is not established. No serial; construction number or erection date recorded

OpenStreetMap node/4348490589. At Donuzlav in annexed Crimea; the OSM ref tag gives RF-57357 which is a RUSSIAN FEDERATION military registration; dedicated to the 78th Independent Shipborne Anti-Submarine Helicopter Regiment. Operator recorded as RU on the strength of the registration. No serial; construction number or erection date recorded
